key_catalyst: Rising Treasury yields and hawkish Fed comments
reasoning: The 10-year yield hit a new multi-year high and hawkish Fed comments reinforce rate hike expectations, directly pressuring QQQ's growth stocks. Oil supply fears add inflation risk, further dimming the outlook for a dovish pivot. The index closed -0.60% after an early pre-market gain, suggesting active selling into strength with no absorption of these macro threats.
